Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling RPG room background, PNG exactly 1536x1024 landscape.
Primary request: a genuinely real, warm everyday VR workshop, cream plaster wall and honey wood fittings, a small front-facing desktop terminal with blank pale screen on a narrow wooden wall desk, a tangible round analog clock without numerals, ordinary closed notebooks, ceramic cup, small tools and a neatly resting VR headset. This is a comfortable real physical room, not a dark cyber environment. Sparse wall-mounted storage. Keep broad central lower wall clear.
Style/medium: polished warm hand-painted anime fantasy game environment, soft cel shading, delicate brown outlines, pale cream, honey wood and quiet sage accents, warm morning sunlight; finished cohesive cozy side-scrolling game art, not photorealistic or 3D.
Composition/framing: strict straight-on orthographic FRONT ELEVATION, camera exactly perpendicular to back wall. Furniture and terminal front faces only. No side walls, corners, vanishing point, angled floor or converging lines. Single uninterrupted flat horizontal platform across full width at y=805 of 1024; a narrow straight top edge, simple cream platform fascia below to bottom. Everything behind platform; open left and right traversal edges on exactly same level. Clear central character travel band. No steps, foreground obstacles or free-standing interaction stations.
Constraints: no people, animals or silhouettes; no text, letters, numbers, labels, signage, UI, logos, border or watermark. Blank screens and book spines. One complete room, 1536x1024 pixels.
